4947:soul:2147.rationale: 自身在场的无视正级、先制、回血减伤、胜之道和攻击记录均为自身行为；仅真实场下支援监听与队伍不武授予延期。
4947:soul:2147.singleBehavior: 实际攻击忽略对手正级，使用时无强授下轮攻击先制；异常分支两回合50%减攻，无异常两回合末30%魂印回复；场上武道开启胜之道并减对手1分不武；实际抵挡后衍化关闭；当前双方完整红伤记录、次轮50%粉伤与严格小于200翻倍。既有不武当前载荷独立验证，点数多分、留存等未决保留显式错误。
4947:soul:2147.deferredBehavior: 存活场下时监听对方不高于10%的抗性触发和通用特性执行，给实际对方队伍添加不武。
4947:soul:2147.trigger: 自身真实存活场下、对方触发相应低概率抗性或执行通用特性
futureMechanisms: 低概率抗性及通用特性实际触发广播
对方队伍不武状态归属

dependencyEvidence.quote: 自身存活于场下时，对方每次触发概率不高于10%的抗性或执行概率不高于10%的通用特性时，对方获得1分不武

success.name: 4947/2147无异常2回合魂印阶段回血，技能禁疗不挡；有异常授50%攻击减伤而不授新回血
success.assertion: test('4947/2147无异常2回合魂印阶段回血，技能禁疗不挡；有异常授50%攻击减伤而不授新回血',()=>{const s=make({move:20309,index:-1,soul:true,hp:3000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗',{});turn(s,20309,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,5700);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['战魂阶段末回复'].end,2);s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']=3;turn(s,20309,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['额外攻击减伤'].fraction,.5);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['战魂阶段末回复'],undefined);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].hp>5700);const bad=make({move:20309,index:-1,soul:true,hp:3000});bad.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']=3;turn(bad,20309,20309);assert.equal(bad.fighters[0].effects['战魂阶段末回复'],undefined);assert.equal(bad.fighters[0].effects['额外攻击减伤'].end,2);});

success.name: 4947/2147攻击无视对手正防御且不清除原级数，负防御仍增伤
success.assertion: test('4947/2147攻击无视对手正防御且不清除原级数，负防御仍增伤',()=>{const values=[];for(const rank of[-2,0,6]){const s=make({move:38539,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[1].stages.def=rank;turn(s,38539,20309);values.push(sum(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,rank);}assert.equal(values[1],values[2]);assert.ok(values[0]>values[1]);});

success.name: 4947/2147实际使用时无强化才授下一回合攻击先制2，属性技能不享受；零PP未使用不授
success.assertion: test('4947/2147实际使用时无强化才授下一回合攻击先制2，属性技能不享受；零PP未使用不授',()=>{const s=make({move:38539,index:-1,soul:true});turn(s,38539,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.battle2147.priorityRound,2);turn(s,38539,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.battle2147.priorityRound,3);const p=make({move:38539,index:-1,soul:true});p.fighters[0].pp['wiki:38539']=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,38539,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.battle2147.priorityRound,undefined);});

success.name: 4947/2147记录双方完整攻击伤害，下一回合真实追加半量粉伤，200边界不翻倍
success.assertion: test('4947/2147记录双方完整攻击伤害，下一回合真实追加半量粉伤，200边界不翻倍',()=>{const s=make({move:38539,index:-1,soul:true});turn(s,38539,10127);const record=sum(s)+sum(s,'attack',1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.battle2147.record.amount,record);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.battle2147.record.round,2);turn(s,38539,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),Math.floor(record*.5));const amounts=[];for(const amount of[199,200]){const x=make({move:38539,index:-1,soul:true});x.fighters[0].soulState.battle2147.record={round:1,amount};turn(x,38539,20309);amounts.push(sum(x));assert.equal(sum(x,'percent'),Math.floor(amount*.5));}assert.ok(amounts[0]>=amounts[1]*1.9);});
